title: Shiraishi An — Meeting On An Errand〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Agreed! Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, good work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you plan to do after this? I'll be going to MEIKO's cafe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll join you then. We've been practicing so much that I haven't dropped by in a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I'll come as well! What about you, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, there's something I have to do after this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you helping your dad out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, something like that! We're super busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't overdo it. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now then...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This spot looks okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm still warmed up and I haven't lost my voice.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which means I can go harder...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Nice. Now to keep this up and...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm projecting even more than before. I guess practice is paying off.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (One more time, while I'm still in the zone...)
<An.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? That voice...
Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup, that's right.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it is you! Why did you pop up all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone except you came to visit us, so I was wondering what was up...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just like I figured, you're practicing alone, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I am.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey, is it okay if I listen to you for a while?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! While you're at it, feel free to give me any pointers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, got it. I'll be listening in then.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, and thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
How was I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I could really feel the power behind your singing. And you sang with a lot of emotion.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It feels like your singing has changed from when I heard you recently.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, recently? When?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Uh... About a week ago, maybe?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ah, it's pitch black... Well, of course it is. She must be practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope I get the chance to hear everyone sing... It's been so long.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (We haven't gotten a chance to meet up in SEKAI lately since they've been practicing with other teams so much.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It sounds like their last event was incredible, and I'm sure they're putting that same energy into their practice.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, there it is.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Huh...? I can only hear An's voice. Maybe she's practicing solo again?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's singing with even more force than usual. But, it's not just that...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's this desperation in her voice that's almost painful, like she's thrashing around trying to grab hold of something.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... So you were there when I was practicing alone that time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I didn't mean to eavesdrop... It's just that I didn't want to disturb you, and I thought there might be other people around.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no need to worry about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More importantly, did you say my singing changed? What did you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The desperation was still there, but I didn't get a sense of pain like I did last time.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <How should I put it... It's like, before, you were thrashing under the water and about to drown, but now you're splashing around on the surface... I guess?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry, that one got away from me.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's okay. I think I got what you meant.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And the reason my singing changed has to be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I never intended to put any painful emotions into my singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, that can't be helped. When we sing, we throw out one big lump of our emotions.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For better or worse, it's pure truth. Of that, I'm sure.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. I'm still in the mood to sing. Can you listen to me practice for a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll listen for as long as you want. I want to hear more of this new An.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!
